notes.purpose: Pilot of the Opus/Sonnet/Haiku comparison (CONCEPT-0122 section 7): measured price per run and per-tier success on 10 synthetic tasks. It reads prices, it adopts nothing.
notes.delta: 0.15 is a smoke value for a 10-task run, not a derived margin. With 10 tasks every comparison is underpowered; the pilot cannot establish non-inferiority.
notes.no_control_arm: Left out on purpose: measured on 2026-10-27, one ~6.1k-token call costs 0.0440 USD on Opus 5.5, 0.0220 on Sonnet 5.5 and about 0.0015 on Haiku 5.5, so a second Opus arm does not fit the 1 USD cap.
